sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Baban Prasad, Advocate For the State : Mr. V. K. Vashistha, Spl.P.P
---------
05/Dated: 14th August, 2023
1.

The applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Hussainabad (Women and Child Protection) P.S. Case No.11 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 323/ 328/ 307/ 34/ 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the D.P.
Act., subsequently converted under Sections 304B/ 328 of the I.P.C, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Hussainabad (Women and Child Protection) P.S. Case No.11 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present anticipatory bail application has become infructuous as the applicant has surrendered in the court below.
3. Learned counsel for the State is present.
4. In view of the submission of learned counsel for the applicant, the present anticipatory bail application stands dismissed as infructuous.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
